summary: Fitme Pro iteration #3 frontend tested end-to-end. All 14 requested scenarios PASSED. Regression baseline holds (30/30 unlocked, BMI=23.5, WHR=0.47). New features all work: metric↔imperial value conversion, input validation with aria-invalid/aria-describedby, Actions dropdown menu with all 5 items, JSON+CSV+PNG downloads with correct filename patterns and payload shape, Snapshot save/restore/delete + Compare page with 30 rows and dropdown selectors including 'Current (live)', per-calculator SEO pages with JSON-LD, all header aria-labels, Reset preserves snapshots, localStorage persistence across reload, and NO horizontal scroll on any viewport.
passed: Dashboard loads at /, 30 cards render, counter '30 / 30 unlocked' after full input; calc-value-bmi=23.5kg/m², calc-value-waist-height-ratio=0.47
Metric→Imperial converts values: height 175→68.9 in, weight 72→158.7 lb; BMI stays 23.5 in both units
Imperial→Metric converts back: height 68.9→175, weight 158.7→72 (BMI 23.5 preserved)
Validation: height=500 shows [data-testid=input-height-error] with text 'Max 250 cm'; input has aria-invalid=true, aria-describedby='height-error'
Valid value clears error (count returns to 0); same behavior for weight=999 and age=200
Unit toggle buttons expose aria-pressed reflecting active state (metric=true, imperial=false initially)
Actions dropdown (nav-actions-trigger) contains action-share-png, action-download-json, action-download-csv, action-snapshots, action-compare-link — all 5 present

Download JSON: file 'fitmepro-results-20260709.json' matches pattern; payload has keys [generatedAt, unit, inputs, results], unit='metric', 30 results, each with id/name/category/value/unit/status/formula
Download CSV: file 'fitmepro-results-20260709.csv'; header row = 'Category,Calculator,Result,Unit,Status,Formula'; 30+1 rows

Snapshots dialog opens via Actions→Snapshots; entering name in snapshot-name-input + snapshot-save-btn adds item; Delete removes it; Restore closes dialog and restores measurement values (height reverted 180→175)
Compare page (/compare): 30 compare-row-{id} rows render; compare-select-a and -b both present; options include 'Current (live)' + saved snapshot(s); changing selections updates A/B/Δ cells
Per-calc SEO: /calculator/bmi title='BMI Calculator — Body Mass Index · Fitme Pro', script#fitme-jsonld present; /calculator/tdee title updates + jsonld present
Header aria-labels: nav-theme-toggle='Toggle theme', nav-reset-btn='Reset all inputs', nav-print-btn='Print or save as PDF', nav-logo='Fitme Pro home' — all exact
Reset (nav-reset-btn) clears all measurement inputs; localStorage key fitmepro:snapshots:v1 still contains saved TEST_BASE snapshot after reset
localStorage persistence: fitmepro:measurements:v1 + fitmepro:snapshots:v1 + fitmepro:theme all persist across reload
No horizontal scroll at 1280×720, 768×1024, 375×667 across /, /calculator/bmi, /compare (docW==winW on all combos)

ui_bugs.issue: After Metric→Imperial→Metric, some length fields drift by 0.1 due to two-step rounding (e.g. neck 38→15→38.1). Cosmetic; results unaffected.

When an input is out-of-range (e.g. height=500 cm shows 'Max 250 cm' error), calculators still compute with that value (BMI shown as 2.9). Consider treating out-of-range as 'not ready' so cards revert to 'Enter missing measurements' rather than showing misleading numbers.

When opening Snapshots dialog via Actions→Snapshots and dismissing the dialog with Escape, the parent DropdownMenu occasionally stays with data-state='open' and its overlay can intercept pointer events on subsequent rapid clicks. Reproducible when tests hit Actions→Snapshots→Escape→Actions immediately. A page click elsewhere resets it. Non-blocking but affects automation & fast users.

action_items: (Optional/LOW) Round conversion only once (not both ways) or store canonical metric value internally to avoid 38→15→38.1 drift on unit toggles
(Optional/LOW) In useAllResults, mark a calculator as not-ready if any required input has a validation error, so out-of-range values don't yield misleading computed cards

(Optional/LOW) Investigate Radix DropdownMenu closing behaviour after a nested Dialog dismissal (perhaps controlled `open` state on the DropdownMenu, or wrap SnapshotDialog outside of the menu with a portal trigger)
critical_code_review_comments: MeasurementContext.setUnit: converts and rounds to 1 decimal every toggle → cumulative drift. Recommend keeping raw metric internally.

exports.js downloadShareCard uses canvas.toBlob without awaiting a Promise wrapper — Playwright download works, but if the caller ever needs to know completion (toast on success) it currently fires 'success' immediately even before the blob is ready.
Compare.jsx defaults bId=options[1] which is fine, but when snapshots reload asynchronously (localStorage read on mount) the default may need to update; verified visually — works correctly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested scenarios pass; 3 LOW cosmetic/UX polish items

seed_data_creation: Created localStorage snapshot 'TEST_BASE' during tests; cleared each run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-3 acceptance criteria pass. Downloads (JSON/CSV/PNG) verified with Playwright expect_download. Snapshot save/delete/restore works, Compare page correctly renders 30 rows with A/B/Δ. Only remaining polish items are: (a) rounding drift on unit round-trips, (b) invalid inputs still compute cards, (c) very minor Radix menu+dialog focus edge case. None blocking.
